ticket_price.note: 2026: General Admission $480 (3 nights camping, Friday and Saturday dinners), Saturday day pass $180, Sunday day pass $120; add-ons: vehicle pass $70, Bower Camp Co. glamping tent $370 (1 person) or $520 (2 people). Subsidised 'low-tide' tickets on request.

partnership_contact.named_person: Rick Bannister (Strategic Communications & Partnerships Manager, Surfers for Climate)

Post (1 Oct 2026): 'We're so grateful to have worked with Bluetti for the last two Water Women Campouts, helping us power these events without relying on fossil fuels.' Same post calls 2026 the 'third annual Water Women campout'.
'WELA is joining Surfers for Climate's (@surfersforclimate) annual Water Women Campout gathering for women leading change in coastal communities' (Google snippet, mid 2026).
'Livi & Amanda from Intuitive Kitchen will be cooking through the weekend' (8 Sep 2026).

Surfers for Climate team page names Rick Bannister as Strategic Communications & Partnerships Manager; general email contact@surfersforclimate.org.au. Campout queries go to caitlin@surfersforclimate.org.au.
Bluetti supplied portable power for the campout (product-in-use partnership); program is workshops, talks and immersive sessions.
